needs_human.note: On a database with stale links, a drive's sidebar count and its listing disagree. On drive B, the row `trip` counts only files linked to B's row (drives.py:829) while choosing it also lists files linked to A's `trip` (drives.py:722-726). On drive A, the row counts the file now sitting on B because list_drive_tags has no File.drive condition, while choosing it omits that file (drives.py:684). The listing half is the parent's behaviour restored; known-issues.md:74-78 records only the count half.; Coexisting variants in one drive still show separate counts while choosing either lists the files of both, as r1 noted and decisions.md step 7 observed. The fix commits did not change or specify this.; A case-variant name on a note renames the shared row (files.py:164-168) while batch tagging a non-Markdown file keeps the existing spelling (files.py:192), so one batch mixing both treats the same request differently. Unchanged since r1.; Matching uses Python str.lower(), not casefold, so `STRASSE` and `straße` stay different tags. Unchanged since r1 and pinned only for lower().
